'''Jondris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the partner of [[Madillis]], a businesswoman. He had images of her stored in his [[Time Piece Model 7643]] [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]] to help him when he missed her during her business trips.<ref name="GFT" />
